title: Pitches from women requesting smaller loan amounts in local currency tend to accelerate funding speed.
Specifying the gender of children may predict faster funding for female borrowers.
Pitches that focus on environmental or ecological concerns tend to fund more slowly for both men and women.
Mentioning specific geographic locations may accelerate funding for female borrowers.
Describing the borrower as hardworking may accelerate funding for female borrowers.
Female borrowers who specify the number of years the business has operated fund faster.
Pitches from women that emphasize business development and growth as a means to provide family security accelerate funding speed.
Mentioning environmental protection may predict slower funding for female borrowers.
Pitches from women that mention growing, expanding, or supporting the business may fund faster.
Mentioning children's schooling or college as a goal may predict slower funding for women.
Mentioning specific institutional or brand names predicts slower funding regardless of gender.
Female borrowers who mention dreams or future aspirations predict slower funding.
Female borrowers who list specific products or goals beyond family welfare fund faster.
Female borrowers who explicitly state their age fund more slowly.
Female borrowers who provide detailed personal backstories fund more slowly.
Female borrowers who mention specific local currency amounts or loan counts fund more slowly.
Explicit expressions of gratitude to lenders accelerate funding for female borrowers.
Specifying the number of years the business has operated predicts faster funding regardless of gender.
